definitions.explanation: The network of nerves, the brain, and the spinal cord that transmits signals throughout the body of an animal. A technical term used in biology, medicine, and health writing.

examples.japanese: {神経系|しんけいけい}を{調|しら}べる。
この{病気|びょうき}は{神経系|しんけいけい}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: This illness affects the nervous system.

examples.japanese: {神経系|しんけいけい}は{脳|のう}と{脊髄|せきずい}と{末梢|まっしょう}{神経|しんけい}から{成|な}り{立|た}っている。
examples.english: The nervous system is made up of the brain, the spinal cord, and the peripheral nerves.

examples.japanese: {交通|こうつう}{事故|じこ}の{後遺症|こういしょう}で{神経系|しんけいけい}の{異常|いじょう}が{出|で}ることがある。
examples.english: Abnormalities of the nervous system sometimes appear as aftereffects of traffic accidents.

notes:
Composed of {神経|しんけい} (nerve, nerves) + {系|けい} (system, lineage, line). The suffix {系|けい} here turns a body-part noun into 'the system of that part,' parallel to {呼吸|こきゅう}{器|き}{系|けい} (respiratory system) and {消化器|しょうかき}{系|けい} (digestive system).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中枢|ちゅうすう}{神経系|しんけいけい}: central nervous system (brain and spinal cord)
- {末梢|まっしょう}{神経系|しんけいけい}: peripheral nervous system
- {自律|じりつ}{神経系|しんけいけい}: autonomic nervous system
- {神経系|しんけいけい}の{疾患|しっかん}: disorders of the nervous system
- {神経系|しんけいけい}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える: to affect the nervous system
- {神経系|しんけいけい}が{発達|はったつ}する: for the nervous system to develop

REGISTER AND USAGE:
A specialist term from biology and medicine. In casual conversation people more often say {神経|しんけい} alone (e.g., 'the nerves are damaged'); {神経系|しんけいけい} is used when the emphasis is on the whole network as a system, especially in textbooks, articles, and clinical writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {神経|しんけい}: nerve(s) — the basic body-part word; refers to individual nerves or nervous tissue rather than the whole system.
- {脳神経|のうしんけい}: cranial nerves — the nerves emerging from the brain.
- {神経細胞|しんけいさいぼう}: neuron; nerve cell — the individual cells that make up the nervous system.
